footer.tagline: Interactive audio playback for live events.

home.title: Interactive Audio Playback for Live Events
home.subtitle: PlayWall arranges media files as tiles on pages, triggered via keyboard, MIDI controller, or mouse — with fading, ramp-in, and end-of-track warnings.
home.heroAlt: PlayWall with an open project: tiles arranged in a grid, some color-coded and mid-playback

features.subtitle: An overview of what PlayWall can do.

download.title: Download
download.subtitle: PlayWall for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
download.linuxInstructions: Linux: extract the archive and run PlayWall/bin/PlayWall.

macos-arm64.name: macOS
macos-arm64.requirements: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later. Apple Silicon (arm64) only — no Intel build available.

linux-amd64.name: Linux
linux-amd64.requirements: glibc 2.17 or later — virtually any distribution.

linux-arm64.name: Linux
linux-arm64.requirements: glibc 2.38 or later (e.g. Debian 13+, Ubuntu 24.04+). Not supported on Debian 12 or Ubuntu 22.04.
